objective.prediction_clip_derivative: one strictly inside (-2,2); zero at endpoints and outside
objective.rho_bound_derivative: zero strictly outside [-1,1] for numerical roundoff safeguard
objective.weight: absolute clipped target; normalized separately per complete sequence and target
objective.degenerate_policy: rho0 and zero correlation gradient when weight<floor or either std<=floor; side retained with correlation loss1
objective.aggregation: equal mean over all batch*2 sequence-target sides, including degenerate and one-sign sides
objective.domain: all TRAIN post-warmup rows; no validation mask or sign-eligibility filtering
objective.teacher: raw selected-ORT predictions, unclipped weighted MSE with same label weights and full-sequence denominator
objective.accumulation: FP64; current ORT FP32 input values preserved; FP64 inputs accepted for derivative audits
objective.coefficient: detached FP32 d(total mean loss)/d(raw prediction), already includes teacher weight and batch*2 mean
objective.chunk_rule: compute once per complete batch; sum(proxy_prediction*coefficient_slice), no extra mean or scaling
objective.gradient_scale: correlation contains inverse prediction standard deviation; previous MSE learning rates are not equivalent
objective.state_scope: future labels used only in training loss; no feature/state/callback mutation

reserved_policy: excluded from new adaptation; inventory is not proof of no prior exposure; pretrained lineage unknown
evaluation_policy: training_only; old round and consumed confirmation remain closed; declare a new bounded evaluation policy before scoring
